_doc: OGRL-20261010-007 (user decision 2026-10-10). Forks run38_d1_wd (the best agent: difficulty 1.0 + weight decay) at switch time and keeps both. Adds the three things that take away its crutches against the scripted AI: opponent personas (50% of fights: patient/passive/berserker/expert/mixed), hidden AI intent (30%), and hop-aware enemies (40%) that ignore small hops and dodge only credible jump kicks (enemycontrol.as RLJumpThreat; validated OGRL-20261010-005/006). Each is drawn independently per episode. Question: do robust r2 cells (personas 1v3, intent hidden, hop-aware) rise without losing suite v2 1v3? Expect suite v2 to dip first.
purpose: OGRL-20261010-007 run39: run38_d1_wd fork + personas 50% + hidden intent 30% + hop-aware enemies 40%
